lifetimes.contract: Owns its new[] backing array; pointer elements are not deleted by the vector destructor. RemoveAtAndDelete explicitly deletes the removed pointee.
Owns and deletes chunk heads; member vectors release their backing arrays separately.
Intrusive ownership: copies addReference, destruction releases, assignment acquires incoming reference before releasing current reference.
Constructed by InitializeNpcDatabase and destroyed by DestroyNpcDatabase; the field is live storage inside a database-sized record.

Shallow-copy spatial view: copy construction copies region/root/triangle pointers; destruction clears them without freeing. m_triangle_vertices borrows the inserter's stack triangle for recursive bounds tests.

Owns malloc-backed branches, leaves, lookup/index streams and m_spatial.m_region_volumes; destruction frees these buffers. BitArray fields and the region-link owner use scalar delete, separately from their backing data.
Allocated with new W8PathSearchNode[g_path_reserve + 0x14] and destroyed with delete[]. Other path buffers use malloc/free, while heap/hash/bitset owners use scalar delete.
Owned W8GameData is destroyed by scalar delete in DestroyWorld; the world clears the pointer afterwards.
Owned quad hierarchy is released by DestroyWorldQuad, separately from game_data and octree destruction.
Borrowed srNode pointers: UpdateWorld disables the nodes and clears the list. World teardown frees list backing storage without deleting the nodes.

Adopts the existing light reference when appended; PLAdoptAppend itself does not addReference. WorldRemoveLight and DestroyWorldLights remove borrowed update-list entries and release each adopted reference; teardown separately frees PList backing storage.

ReadMeshFile allocates position/LOD/face buffers with malloc. WriteMeshFile consumes the mesh and frees vertex/face buffers and each LOD frame after writing; existing error paths and pointer-table release behavior are preserved.
